question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **grabbing**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context tells us that we must learn to resist our impulse to obtain that burger, hotdog, pizza, samosa, kachori, or even ice cream the next time we're at a party, restaurant, or eating establishment.
 
• **Grabbing (पकड़ना) **means to take hold of something (in this case, 'food') which fits the blank contextually.
 
• Other options ("**skipping**", "**grabbing**", "**building**") do not fit the context of describing the ongoing process in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Nutrition experts have researched the bad effects of junk food and have come to the conclusion that junk food manufacturing companies are fooling the people by showing deceptive advertisements that show junk food as healthy. We must substitute junk food with **healthier **food like fruits and vegetables. So the next time you think of **grabbing**__ that burger, hotdog, pizza, samosa, kachori or even ice cream in a restaurant, eating joint or a party, stop your instincts and look for some healthier food options instead.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Skipping (छोड़ना):** "Skipping" means to omit or leave out.
 
• **Turning (मोड़):** "Turning" means to move your body, or part of your body, so that you are facing in a different direction.
 
• **Building (निर्माण करना): **"Building" means to construct.

T
